 University of Arkansas at Fort Smith to host Freaky FAFSA event Oct. 29

 River Valley Democrat-Gazette
 -->

 Volunteers and students with their families gather to unload belongings Aug. 16, 2024, during move-in day at the University of Arkansas at Fort Smith campus.
(File Photo/River Valley Democrat-Gazette/Hank Layton) 
 FORT SMITH -- The University of Arkansas at Fort Smith will host its annual Halloween-themed Freaky FAFSA event from 5:30-7:30 p.m. Thursday in Room 129 of the Smith-Pendergraft Campus Center.
 The free, drop-in event gives students and families an opportunity to receive help completing the 2027-28 Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA), which opened in October, according to a news release from the university.
 Members of the UAFS Financial Aid team will be available to answer questions, guide students through the application and help them understand their financial aid options.
 Students who attend Freaky FAFSA and complete their 2027-28 FAFSA by Dec. 1 will be eligible to win one of five $1,000 scholarships for the 2027-2028 academic year, according to the release.
 One scholarship recipient will be announced following the event, with four additional scholarships awarded to eligible students after Dec 1, the release states.
